title: संजीवनी पर्वत कितना भारी था?
style: Painted-realism vector characters (remotion/src/kit/real.tsx) in lit 2.5D scenes. NO subtitles, no text, no numbers, no labels; measurements shown only as lines and comparisons.

shots.title: Hanuman lifts the mountain
shots.pick: Night sky over clouds: Hanuman flies holding a whole peak overhead — trees and elephants on it.

shots.title: How heavy?
shots.pick: Under the floating peak, Hanuman looks up at it; it creaks and sways.

shots.title: Valmiki's Ramayana
shots.pick: Valmiki writes on palm leaves by a lamp; the leaf glows as the verse is chanted.

shots.title: What was on it
shots.pick: Hanuman tears the peak free; cutaway: trees, elephants, gold veins and crystals light up one by one.

shots.title: Size
shots.pick: The peak as a cone; a measuring line grows across its base, then up its height.

shots.title: Weight
shots.pick: Wireframe cone drops onto a golden balance; the pan slams down.

shots.title: Crane
shots.pick: The world's biggest crane lifts its record load; pull back: the mountain dwarfs it, its shape filled with countless such loads.

shots.title: Just the start
shots.pick: Hanuman crouches and launches upward with the peak; shockwave in the clouds.

shots.title: Himalaya to Lanka
shots.pick: A map of India: a glowing trail from the Himalaya to Lanka streaks in one go.

shots.title: Twice sound
shots.pick: Hanuman bursts through a vapour cone — two shock rings.

shots.title: Energy
shots.pick: The moving mountain blazes with energy; rings of force roll over the clouds.

shots.title: Even more
shots.pick: Night battlefield: wounded warriors lie still; the herbs on the peak begin to glow.

shots.title: Back to the Himalaya
shots.pick: Warriors rise healed; Hanuman flies the peak back and sets it on the snowy Himalaya at dawn.
